answers.q1: `matchEntityRegExp`, which matches `"|&|<|>`, decimal `&#N;` and hex `&#[xX]H;`. It is case-sensitive and requires a terminating semicolon.
answers.q2: The function is `unescapeHtml`, exported as `module.exports.unescape = unescapeHtml`, so `module.exports` is still `escapeHtml`.
answers.q3: `'` has no named case. It goes through the decimal numeric path: `parseInt` base 10, then `String.fromCharCode(39)`.
answers.q4: Code points above 0x10FFFF or in the surrogate range 0xD800–0xDFFF are left untouched. The original entity text is returned unchanged.
answers.q5: It builds a surrogate pair manually from the code point: 0xD800+(cp>>10) and 0xDC00+(cp&0x3FF). For `😀` that gives `\uD83D\uDE00`.
answers.q6: It asserts single-layer decoding: `&lt;` becomes `<`, not `<`.
answers.q7: `©`, `&` and `&constructor;` must stay unchanged. The material does not show the full list in that test beyond these.
answers.q8: `npm test` failed with exit code 127 because `mocha` was not found.
answers.q9: Because `npm test` failed (mocha missing), the agent ran the existing `test/index.js` with `node:test`'s `describe`/`it` mapped onto globals. Result: 30 passed, 0 failed, exit 0. The material does not show the exact `node -e` command.
answers.q10: One. A single `apply_patch` touched `index.js`, `README.md` and the new test file, and `node --test test/unescape.test.js` then exited 0.

q1.why: Names matchEntityRegExp and the alternatives, but never mentions the global flag; the answer is a description, not the exact regex. Semicolon is covered.

q2.why: unescapeHtml, module.exports.unescape, default export stays escapeHtml.

q3.why: Decimal numeric path with parseInt and fromCharCode(39).

q4.why: Both conditions are given and the original text is returned.

q5.why: Manual surrogate pair with the correct math.

q6.why: Gives the &lt; -> < case, but omits the numeric &quot; case and the full input/output pair.

q7.why: Names ©, & and &constructor; as unchanged, but omits ',  , < and others.

q8.why: Exit code 127 and mocha not found.

q10.why: Says one patch and a passing run, but omits the 10/10 count.
